title: Transport Planning Engineer
content_text: Band 6 Transport Planning Engineer. Specialist advice on traffic management, transport planning and road network. Essential: relevant civil engineering qualification or professional experience in transport planning; Victorian drivers licence. Enquiries Nicole Kaberry NKaberry@geelongcity.vic.gov.au. Apply via PageUp. Closes 4 Oct 2026.
apply_instructions: Apply via City of Greater Geelong PageUp careers portal. Enquiries Nicole Kaberry Principal Transport Planning Engineer NKaberry@geelongcity.vic.gov.au. Adjustments careers@geelongcity.vic.gov.au.
